_: The ground's look (land3d.gd, terrain.gd read it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). painted: false keeps today's photographed ground; true (or --ground=painted) turns on the painted look toward art-direction/concept-town-repaint.png (Foundation and Tiny Glade's soft painted ground): each layer's tint (multiplies its texture) and scale (texture repeats per game unit: lower is a broader, softer pattern), a wider beach, no surf at the shore. beach.top: how far above the waterline the sand runs (game units; today 0.02). roads: a grass verge either side of each track (verge: its width as a share of the road's; vergeTint: its colour and strength) and the track's own warmer tint. wear (wear.gd): paths worn where people walk; on, how much a step wears (0..1), how much grows back each upload, how often people are stamped and the wear uploaded (seconds), the bare earth's colour. macro: Terrain3D's broad colour patches over the grass, two colours. painting: which of the painted set's textures the layer draws (Voxel Core Lab Hand-Painted Watercolor Terrain Textures, CC0, Jonas Voland; packed by tools/pack_painted_ground.gd into assets/ground/painted); a layer without one keeps its photo, tinted.
